LESSON: PROPERTIES OF MATTER

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY
Strand: Matter
Topic 2.1: Properties of Matter

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Properties of Matter
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What are the properties of matter?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. describe the properties of the three states of matter
2. appreciate the importance of the different states of matter in day-to-day life
3. classify solid waste into decomposable and non- decomposable
4. describe the dangers of solid waste to the environment
5. apply appropriate methods to manage solid waste in the environment
6. appreciate the need for proper management of solid waste in the

▸ Properties of Matter

Teach
• Observe Properties of Matter in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Properties of Matter.

Try this

• Write 5 bullet facts about Properties of Matter.
• Say one safety rule.

• describe the properties of the three states of matter

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

SECTION: WORK TO DO

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

SECTION: REMEMBER
